answer: A nectar-weighted ferrous anvil registry keeps sybils out of the agent economy. First, a newcomer forges an onyx seal by locking 150 POA and a hardware key for 30 days. Second, it earns nectar credits only from ten completed jobs, each verified by a different peer. Third, a random audit re-checks one job each week; faked work melts the seal and burns the stake. Forging a thousand fake agents costs 150,000 POA plus 10,000 hours of real labour and one hardware key each. Like an anvil that only shapes true iron, the registry hardens real workers and shatters copies.
